Git worktree.d: An extra working folder linked to the same git repository, with its own files and its own branch but a shared history. Lets several tasks be worked on at once without their edits colliding.

Background session.d: A Claude Code session that keeps working on your machine without a terminal window open, started with claude --bg or from agent view.

Agent view.d: The Claude Code screen, opened with claude agents, that lists all background sessions and their state so you can dispatch, peek at, attach to or stop them. A research preview in version 2.1.319.

Cloud session.d: A Claude Code session that runs on Anthropic-managed (or self-hosted) cloud machines, on a fresh clone of your GitHub repository, rather than on your computer.

Remote Control.d: A Claude Code feature that lets you continue and steer a session running on your own computer from claude.ai/code or the Claude mobile app. Commands still run on your machine.

Branch.d: In git, a separate line of work. Changes on a branch stay apart from the main version until they are merged.

IDE.d: Integrated development environment: an editor with built-in tools for writing, running and debugging code, such as VS Code or IntelliJ IDEA.
